multiple_rationale: Author-selected 4x/6x/8x/10x multiples around an assumed 8x starting mark. These are mechanical scenarios, not market comparables or a fair-value opinion.
earnings_rationale: Apply -10%, unchanged and +10% to the historical calculated EBITDA solely to inspect sensitivity. No consolidated forward forecast, post-Domo perimeter or normalized maintainable earnings is established. These factors are not estimated probabilities.
capital_structure_rationale: Carry the selected historical half-cash convention, debt principal and other claim assumptions unchanged into every sensitivity. No debt paydown, retained cash generation, post-Domo financing, ownership allocation or settlement is inferred; this deliberately incomplete capital bridge cannot establish proceeds.
operating_scope_rationale: The constructed renewal/service/collections records cover scoped economic pools, not consolidated accounts. Keep their monthly economics separate; no mapping establishes a maintainable company earnings increment. Expired contracts, missing vendor release and continuing costs remain visible.
